name: Goddess Saraswati
shortDescription: Goddess of knowledge, music and the arts, clothed in white.
description: Saraswati, clothed in white and seated by the flowing river, is the source of speech, learning, music and the arts. The veena, the sacred book and the white lotus are her companions. Students, artists and seekers come to her for clarity of mind and purity of expression.

art.imageAlt: Veena with a palm-leaf manuscript and white lotus
